_readme: DRAFT themes for the daily game. A theme is a named family of statistics; a day picks three of them. Edit freely: add/remove ids (see data/stats.json), rename, retitle. 'blurb' is the one-line framing a player could see. Counted by tools/pipeline/themes.mjs. 'maxDaysPerYear' caps how often a theme may appear in one year. A theme marked 'filler' has no cap and fills whatever the capped themes leave.
